title: Terminal-Bench 2.1: signal-only versus classifier-enabled staged routing
analysis_request: Compare complete Terminal-Bench 2.1 runs that differ only in whether GLM 5.2 is consulted for ambiguous staged-router requests. Use the signal-only arm as the observed control. Emphasize final pass@1, observed completion-target cost, the same-workload all-Sol counterfactual, routing-only token/cost coverage, request-level decision source and confidence, model choice, cache efficiency, latency, and task-aligned effects. Do not claim provider-invoice savings from the catalog-derived cost model.

analysis_contract.primary_variation: one independent completed run per configuration; compare paired task outcomes and do not imply replicate-level variance
analysis_contract.cost_baseline: signal-only staged-router run as observed control, plus each run's same-workload all-Sol counterfactual
analysis_contract.routing_overhead: dedicated switchyard.routing.llm_call ATOF usage marks, priced by the run-bound catalog only when complete usage coverage is present
analysis_contract.paired_comparison: task-aligned paired binary comparison over complete task outcomes
primary_plots: observed cost versus same-workload all-Sol counterfactual
secondary_sections: exact router, classifier, model, transport, and pricing settings
cost coverage, telemetry reconciliation, and limitations
